citation.title: Designing Porous Structure with Optimized Topology using Machine Learning
citation.authors: Shradha Ghansiyal; Yi Li; Matthias Klar; Jan Christian Aurich
citation.version_coded: abstract only (reconstructed from OpenAlex, https://api.openalex.org/works/W4402298820); no legal full-text route could be reached

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract states that machine-learning models used in place of conventional numerical-simulation-based topology optimization give a significant decrease in computation time with comparable optimization performance to conventional methods, for porous structures aimed at biomedical prostheses/orthoses; no specific number is given.
claim.key_phrase: significant decrease in computation time, along with comparable optimization performance to conventional methods
claim.location: abstract (no fuller text accessible); qualitative comparison taken as primary outcome per §5.1 rule 3, since the abstract's comparison is not quantitative
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not derivable: the abstract states only a qualitative 'significant decrease in computation time', no numeric factor, baseline time, or ML time is given.
claim.alternatives: None identifiable from the abstract alone.
